_about: What is said in the Gennoor AI Weekend film. One entry is one breath of narration. `pad` is the silence after it, in seconds. No dates and no price: both change, and the page carries them.

lines.text: What could you build with Claude in one weekend?
Come and see. Two live sessions. One Saturday, one Sunday.
On day one, we set Claude up to know your work. A context file, so the answers stop being generic.
A weekly report, in minutes. And a workspace where Claude reads your files, and drafts directly.
On day two, we automate a task you repeat every week. We build a small working app, just by describing it.
And we build your first agent. Give it a goal, and it researches, drafts, and checks its own work.
Everything is built live, step by step. Then you get the complete kit, so you can repeat it yourself.
The AI Weekend. Live, online, the last weekend of every month.
Reserve your seat. The link is on the screen.
